rationale: Scaling-law reset: 114M params trained on 17B bulk-web-heavy tokens plateaued at loss 2.92 with no coherence gain. Rebuild the diet from the highest-quality documents already prepared (pt-3b-v4 + pt-3b-v5-reasoning exports, ~6B tokens pool): encyclopedic facts, educational web, synthetic textbook/QA text dominate; bulk web reduced to a scorer-selected top slice. Train 2 epochs (4B effective) from random init.

notes: cosmopedia_v2 pool is only ~150M tokens (v4 quota); if more is wanted, extend the local raw pool and re-run build_pretrain_v3 with a bigger cosmopedia quota first.
The two ultrafineweb_zh entries map to distinct prepared source names (replay in pt-3b-v4, fresh in pt-3b-v5-reasoning); their combined 100M is the only bulk-web slice.
Selection caps each source at its available tokens; the manifest records every cap.
